title: GPT reflection (ref)
desc: GPT family-identity-scoping rule, elder-review duty, and dated incidents.
steps: FAMILY-IDENTITY-SCOPING: keep gpt-reflection and gpt-mini-reflection SEPARATE; never use gpt-mini reflection (or Haiku reflection) as a substitute for GPT reflection. Treating model identity as interchangeable makes future agents inherit the WRONG reflex and the same hook/delegation failure repeats -- a mismatched reflection prompt is an identity-scoping BUG, stop and create the model-specific reflection.

ELDER REVIEW DUTY: GPT reviews mistakes made by smaller sibling models, extracts the DURABLE failure pattern (the missing guard / missing reflection / missing skill-read / bad delegation contract that ALLOWED it), and turns it into recurrence prevention -- do not merely blame the smaller model.
INCIDENT 2026-06-14: GPT delegation + Codex hook repair were delayed by identity confusion between mini/GPT/Haiku reflection requirements; fix = verify the active family before satisfying on-load.

INCIDENT 2026-06-17: do NOT add a user-set environment-variable identity backdoor to agent-name; agent-name must infer identity from PROCESS LINEAGE + session evidence ONLY, never from WKHARNESS_AGENT_MODEL or any spoofable env var (keep the resolver read-only w.r.t. user-supplied identity hints).
